name: qfd_su_lane_h-sp1-COMMIT
purpose: el1013-qwen-stalls sp1: Lane head ot_hdc_vstream_lane_h (11,844 flops + 1 SRAM): the tile's pin flops, address cycle, ML tag line, 4 multipliers + adder, write; tapped line in the SRAM ring. Leaf of the Qwen3-8B ROM TP8 SU lane (ot_hdc_vstream_lane_t at ML15, QLA4/QLM5), M5 cap, local CTS, recipe 2, every pin registered, own reset register; pins face the lane group's 43.2 um channel. Benches run on the ASSEMBLED parent (tb_qfd_su_vm_bv VL=15 LT=1 RD=2: master + tiled vector memory + 8 lane wrappers of these four leaves).
